sentences.text: Mukhyamantri Ati Pichhada Varg Udyami Yojana

**Scheme Brief Description:** This is a flagship scheme of the Bihar government aimed at promoting entrepreneurship and self-employment among the youth by providing financial assistance of up to ₹10,00,000/- for setting up businesses.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Business & Entrepreneurship; Sector: Setting up / start-up / entrepreneurship

**Detailed Description:** The “Mukhyamantri Ati Pichhada Varg Udyami Yojana” is a component of the umbrella scheme “Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana”, launched by the Department of Industries, Bihar. The main objective of the scheme is to promote entrepreneurship and self-employment among individuals from all categories in the state. Under this component, financial assistance of up to ₹10,00,000/- is provided to male applicants from the General Category and Backward Class for establishing and operating business ventures, thereby fostering economic growth and empowerment in the state.

**Benefits / Assistance:** - **Substantial Financial Support:** Up to ₹10,00,000/- for setting up a business (50% of the total financial assistance (up to ₹5,00,000/-) is provided as a non-repayable grant. The remaining 50% (up to ₹5,00,000/-) is offered as an interest-free loan, with a nominal 1% interest under specific sub-schemes.) - **Skill Development:** Mandatory training sessions are provided to enhance entrepreneurial skills.

**Application Process:** > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the official [website ](https://udyamiuser.bihar.gov.in/login)and click on "[Registration/Log in](https://udyami.bihar.gov.in/mmuy)". Select "Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana" as "MMUY". **Step 2:** A new page will open where you need to enter your Aadhaar number and create a desired password. **Step 3:** Click on the "Login" option after entering the details. **Step 4:**A registration form will appear. Fill in the required details carefully. **Step 5:** Once completed, click on the "Submit" button to finalize your registration. > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** After successful registration, [log in](https://udyamiuser.bihar.gov.in/login) to the portal using your Aadhaar number and password. **Step 2:** The application form will appear on your dashboard. Fill in the form accurately with all the necessary details. **Step 3:** Upload all the required documents as specified in the instructions. **Step 4:** Review the application to ensure all information is correct. **Step 5:** Click on the "Submit" button to complete the application process. **Step 6:** Download and print the acknowledgment receipt for your records. Keep it safe for future correspondence.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Department of Industries
**Tags:** Entrepreneurship, Youth, Business, Self Employment, Extremely Backward Class
